svg.title: Red Orange (Maya)
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Two observed red rounded forms on an orange rectangular ground, touching at the centre. Museum checklist width19in and curator article18½in disagree; museum checklist aspect retained. Visual reference is the museum chief curator’s illustrated article, Fig.10. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.thewadsworth.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/post-war_contemporary_checklist.pdf; source object 1992.11; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
